text:
emily: Quick heads up — spotted ~1.2% of inbound HubSpot contacts routed to the fallback queue overnight (02:10-02:35 UTC). Enrichment webhook returned 504s and the RR job appears to skip assignment when enrichment tag missing. Leaving this thread for triage and short-term mitigation. @raj @maria

raj: Ack. Thanks for flagging. Can you paste the webhook failure snippet? Is it a spike or sustained?

emily: Paste from the webhook logs: ```POST /enrichments 504 02:12:08 body: {"contactId": "xxx"} resp_time=30002ms``` Looks like timeout causing enrichment step to fail -> fallback route. Spike lasted ~25m, ~450 contacts affected.

maria: Ugh. That will trip our HubSpot workflow branch that checks `enriched=true` and then RR. If enrichment fails the contact falls into fallback queue which is manual triage.

ben: Propose immediate mitigations: 1) extend claim window to 10m for EMEA/overnight flows, 2) temporarily enable a permissive RR branch that assigns without enrichment if source == "web" and score > 0.7, 3) fire a backfill for fallback queue. Which one do we want now?

emily: I like (3) + (1) now. Backfill will keep reps fed and extending claim window prevents churn during the noisy window. Can ops toggle the claim window?

ops-bot: ops-bot: change request received: set `claim_window_seconds` from `300` -> `600` for workspace `marketing-intake` during 00:00-06:00 UTC. Need an approver.

maria: Approving. Also add a short-term rule in HubSpot: if `lead_score >= 70` AND `enriched IS NULL` then route to RR instead of fallback. That avoids sending good leads to manual triage. I can patch the workflow for 48h.

raj: Maria — when you patch, leave a toggle so we can revert after backfill. Also add an audit tag `rr_temp_assign=true` so we can count and evaluate.

ben: I'll start the backfill job now. Command: ```python backfill_fallback.py --since "2026-03-22T02:00:00Z" --until "2026-03-22T03:00:00Z" --dry-run``` Running in dry-run then real.

leadflow-bot: leadflow-bot: scheduled backfill dry-run queued (job id: bf-20260322-01). Estimated matches: 412 contacts.

emily: Thanks team. Quick ask for observability: can we add a heartbeat metric for enrichment success rate and a PagerDuty alert threshold (>=0.5% failed enriched leads in 15m)? Right now we only alert on infra latency, not on downstream routing impact.

raj: Good call. I'll add a prometheus rule: `rate(enrichment_failures[5m]) / rate(enrichment_requests[5m]) > 0.005` and wire to PD with low-priority page to oncall.

maria: One more note — Salesforce sync can amplify this if HS gives a fallback owner of `unassigned`. After backfill we should run a reconcile: `select id from contacts where owner = 'unassigned' and created_at > '2026-03-22'`. I'll own that.

ben: Backfill completed (real run) — job id bf-20260322-01 completed, reassigned 403 contacts, 9 failures (retriable). Logging uploaded to s3://redwood-backfills/bf-20260322-01/logs.txt

emily: Nice. Keep the claim_window extension in place for one more overnight and let's review impact tomorrow AM (metric: assigned% within 10m). Also keep the RR permissive patch but gated behind the toggle.

raj: Noted. I'll create a short playbook snippet for on-call so next time we can triage faster: steps = [check enrichment success rate, check webhook latencies, flip claim_window, run backfill, patch HS permissive rule]. Adding to /docs/handbooks/marketing/inbound-routing-playbook.md (draft link: https://redwood.internal/docs/routing-playbook).

emily: Perfect. Thanks everyone — tagging SDR lead to watch inbox: @maria. :thumbsup:

leadflow-bot: leadflow-bot: metric alert created (rule id: enrich-fail-rate-20260322). PagerDuty integration pending.

ops-bot: ops-bot: claim_window change applied for schedule window.

maria: I'll run reconcile at 09:30 UTC and post results here.

emily: Closing the loop: postmortem draft will include cause (enrichment webhook timeouts), short-term mitigations (claim_window, HS permissive branch, backfill), and long-term actions (heartbeat alert, retry/backoff for webhook, SLA with enrichment vendor).
